newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-CHESTER WILLIAMS ATTEMPTS COMEBACK.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CHESTER WILLIAMS ATTEMPTS COMEBACK.

text.p: Springbok wing Chester Williams, out of rugby for eight months through injury, is planning the next stage of his comeback.
Williams, who has not played since February 19 when he damaged knee ligaments in a friendly between Western Province and Canterbury, will appear in trials next week for the South African sevens team.
The Springboks will be appearing at the Dubai Sevens on November 21-22, one of three qualifying tournaments for the World Cup Sevens in Hong Kong next March.
